title: The Brocade Platypus of Parcel Day
description: On Parcel Day, the platypus brings gifts across the river in a reed raft. The neighbors at the landing have brought a basket big enough for every parcel.
alt: A platypus in a plum brocade cape rides a reed raft loaded with wrapped parcels toward three people waiting at a misty river landing.
pairing: An imagined midwinter gift exchange × a platypus ferrying parcels across the river
